## Description
Briefly describe the purpose of this change and the rationale behind it.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Refactoring / Code style improvement

## Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the package-by-capability architecture guidelines.
- [ ] I have added unit tests for my changes.
- [ ] All tests pass locally with `go test -race ./...`.
- [ ] I have verified that static analysis passes with `golangci-lint run`.
- [ ] I have updated documentation in `docs/` or `README.md` if applicable.
- [ ] My commits follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/).
